threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look around confused when the bus driver shouts out street names like they've just won a jackpot. Just wait till you get used to it.
Caught a glimpse of someone arguing with a statue outside the Ritzy last night. Guess even the bus drivers have a bit of late-night drama to share.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted that little corner store selling fresh baklava at 2 AM. The sweet smell wafted through the street, and I thought, 'Yep, this is home.'

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous open-air films in the middle of the park, complete with a packed picnic vibe and strangers sharing snacks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they shrug off BART delays. A newbie panics; we just check Twitter and grab a burrito.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission packed with chatty tourists, but hilarious when a local yelled, 'Look, it’s the bus tour!' Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are for chillin', but locals know they're just the backstage for evening pregames before heading out.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitation at the metro ticket machines—standing there baffled while locals swipe on autopilot.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's a 'nice' cafe if it serves soy lattes. Locals know it's about the vibe, not the menu.
Caught a glimpse of a guy singing to a traffic cone outside the Ritzy – thought it was just late-night madness until he started beatboxing too.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I found a flyer for a silent disco at a local laundromat — only in Neukölln do you disco while your clothes spin.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find parties in abandoned buildings where art installations double as DJ booths. You'll never feel more alive in a concrete jungle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by how they react when a BART delay is announced—eyes roll, but there's an unspoken acceptance. Newbies panic.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in pajamas trying to catch the 27, shouting at the driver like it was a personal betrayal. Classic Tenderloin hustle.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can stroll into the local markets at any hour. Most close by 2 PM for siesta, missing the best local buzz.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still fumbling with their metros while staring at a map, blissfully unaware of the shortcuts through the winding streets.
